title.zh: 国民登记（罪行构成）条例 2016
title.vi: Quy chế Đăng ký Quốc gia (Hòa giải tội phạm) 2016
title.th: ข้อบังคับการทะเบียนแห่งชาติ (การประนีประนอมความผิด) 2016

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the National Registration (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2016 and come into operation on 1 January 2017.

2. Any offence under section 16(1)(a), (b) or (d) of the Act, or regulation 17(4) or 20 of the National Registration Regulations (Rg 2), may be compounded in accordance with section 28 of the Act by —
(a)the Commissioner; or
(b)a registration officer appointed under section 3(4) of the Act for the purposes of section 28 of the Act.
[S 499/2023 wef 31/12/2021]
